entries.text: 修复 type1 查询折叠的 CTE 处理逻辑
entries.textEn: Fixed CTE handling in type-1 query folding

entries.text: 性能优化：在线工作空间表数超过阈值时先取 SQL 中的表列表，避免解析所有表对象
entries.textEn: Performance: above the table threshold an online workspace resolves only the tables named in the SQL

entries.text: 子查询解关联代价算法优化：仅当外查询行数小于内查询时才解关联
entries.textEn: Subquery decorrelation costing: decorrelate only when the outer row count is smaller

entries.text: 区分 TimestampDiff(date1, date2) 与 TimestampDiff(type, startTS, endTS) 两种语法的重写
entries.textEn: The rewrite distinguishes TimestampDiff(date1, date2) from TimestampDiff(type, startTS, endTS)

entries.text: 修正达梦数据库的连接串
SQL Server 允许 ID 作为 token
entries.textEn: SQL Server allows ID as a token

entries.text: sqlparser 支持 create table like 语法
entries.textEn: The SQL parser supports create table like

entries.text: 在线 DDL 解析默认使用第一个 schema
entries.textEn: Online DDL parsing defaults to the first schema

entries.text: schema 解析时忽略传入的 NULL 元素
entries.textEn: NULL elements passed to schema parsing are ignored

entries.text: 索引推荐修复派生表关联条件被误处理为过滤条件的缺陷
entries.textEn: Index recommendation: fixed derived-table join conditions being treated as filters

entries.text: RuleUpDeleteWithLimitWarning 只检查 update；RuleMaxMinAggRewrite 支持 dummy 列
entries.textEn: RuleUpDeleteWithLimitWarning checks update only; RuleMaxMinAggRewrite supports dummy columns

entries.text: 新增 RuleShardingTables2Replicated、RuleSubqueryPredicatePushDownRewrite、RuleUnionConstantRewrite、RuleDeleteWithLimitWarning，并整理 sharding 规则目录
entries.textEn: Added RuleShardingTables2Replicated, RuleSubqueryPredicatePushDownRewrite, RuleUnionConstantRewrite and RuleDeleteWithLimitWarning, and reorganised the sharding rules directory

entries.text: FOR UPDATE 告警规则：未命中唯一性索引时提示评估乐观锁
entries.textEn: FOR UPDATE rule: suggest evaluating optimistic locking when no unique index is matched

entries.text: 其余内部改动（3 条提交）
